description: The chart, labeled "Figure 3: Results of Ablation Study," is a grouped bar chart that compares the accuracy of different models on two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact. The horizontal axis contains the categories, with labels "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition," while the vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 75% to 95% in increments of 2.5%. The chart is divided into two groups, one for each dataset, with PHEME on the left and PolitiFact on the right, and each group contains five bars corresponding to the different categories. The bars for PHEME have approximate accuracy values of 80.1%, 80.8%, 86.7%, 88.1%, and 89.8%, while the bars for PolitiFact have approximate accuracy values of 83.0%, 83.0%, 86.6%, 90.1%, and 90.6%. The bars are colored in different shades, with the tallest bar in each group being the darkest shade, representing the "DAE (Ours)" model, and the other bars being lighter shades. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
